svgOpen: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="iso-svg" viewBox="0 0 760 420" role="img" aria-label="A minting bench. A gold bar leaves the vault of the custodian, and the reserve meter counts it. The bar rides a track into the mint press, which stamps it into a token. The token rides a belt through the investor check gate. A token for a verified investor goes into the wallet. A token for an investor over the limit is pushed into the held tray for review.">
